title: Adobe Software India Tops Digital Ad Impressions in India Growth Surge
seo_title: Adobe Software India Leads India Digital Ad Impressions Growth in 2026
seo_description: Discover how Adobe Software India emerged as the top advertiser as digital ad impressions grew 44% in India during January-July 2026, according to TAM AdEx.
reader_question: Who was the top digital advertiser in India between January and July 2026?
dek: TAM AdEx data reveals a 44% surge in India's digital ad impressions for early 2026, with Adobe Software India leading advertisers.
signal: Adobe Software India captured the highest share of digital advertising impressions in India during the first seven months of 2026, amid a broader 44% year-over-year expansion in digital ad impressions reported by TAM AdEx.
lesson: Brands scaling their digital footprint in high-growth markets can leverage dominant web publishers and programmatic networks to capture attention during periods of rapid advertising expansion.

sections.heading: Digital Ad Impressions Surge in India
paragraphs: Digital advertising in India recorded a 44% increase in ad impressions in January-July 2026 compared with the same period in 2025, according to TAM AdEx data. Adobe Software India stood out during this period by securing the position of top advertiser on digital platforms, accounting for 4% of total ad impressions.
The report says that Flipkart.com and OpenAI followed closely behind with a 3% share each, while Amazon Online India and Reliance Retail each accounted for 2% of digital ad impressions.
bullets: Total digital ad impressions grew by 44% year-over-year in January-July 2026.
Adobe Software India led advertisers with a 4% share.
Over 168,000 exclusive advertisers were recorded on digital channels during the period.

sections.heading: Top Sectors and Fastest-Growing Categories
paragraphs: The services sector maintained its dominance, accounting for 47% of digital ad impressions during the January-July 2026 timeframe. Within the category breakdown, Ecom-Other Services ranked first with a 10% share, replacing Ecom-Online Shopping from the leading position it held in the corresponding period of 2025.

According to the report, several categories experienced rapid growth, with Ecom-Real Estate expanding by 90%, Lifestyle growing by 92%, and Ecom-Other Services increasing ad impressions by 85% compared to the year-ago period.
bullets: Services sector retained the top position with 47% of ad impressions.
Ecom-Other Services captured a 10% share to rank first among categories.
Lifestyle and Ecom-Real Estate saw massive year-over-year growth exceeding 90%.

sections.heading: Publisher Share and Transaction Methods
paragraphs: Instagram led web publishers with a 69% share of digital ad impressions, followed by Facebook.com at 41%, YouTube.com at 23%, and X.com at 15%. Together, the top five web publishers accounted for 83% of ad impressions during the evaluated months.

In terms of platforms and transaction types, display advertising dominated as the leading digital platform with a 91% share, leaving video at 9%. Furthermore, programmatic emerged as the most widely used transaction method, accounting for 96% of digital ad impressions.
bullets: Instagram led web publishers with a 69% share of impressions.
Display ads accounted for 91% of digital formats.
Programmatic transactions drove 96% of digital ad impressions.
